text:
ana: quick sync — target is the v2 compatibility rollout next month. need final owners for SDK adapter, routing fallback, docs/email. who can take which?
kevin: i can own the SDK adapter + compat shim. aiming to open PR by end of day.
riley: i'll own routing fallback and rule mapping. will need infra support for warm pools. tagging @michael.
michael: noted. infra needs a curated route list + expected QPS per route. can you paste the routes here?
riley: short list below:
```
- /v1/generate -> /v2/generate (param rename: model_id -> model)
- /v1/chat -> /v2/chat (role order differences)
- /v1/embed -> /v2/embeddings (response shape: vector vs object)
```
kevin: SDK shim plan: keep a thin adapter mapping old params to new v2 fields and emit a deprecation warning. I'll preserve `include_metadata` for 2 weeks then drop. PR link when ready.
jordan: i'll draft the deprecation announcement and migration guide. need sample snippets from SDK + server.
michael: infra ask: canary config for 10% traffic shift + automatic rollback on 5xx spike; also fallback to dedicated capacity if latency > 500ms for 2 consecutive mins. i'll create a ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued for branch 'v2-compat-shim' — ETA ~18m
ci-bot: CI detected 2 flaky tests impacting adapter: test_sleep_randomness, test_batching. @kevin can you take a look?
kevin: on it, will patch tests and update PR.
ana (typo earlier — correcting): nvm, meant ana :)
ana: action items recap — kevin (SDK shim + PR), riley (routing fallback + route QPS), jordan (docs + email), michael (canary + infra ticket). update checklist below as you make progress. :memo:

CHECKLIST:
- [ ] SDK shim PR merged
- [ ] Canary infra config created
- [ ] Routing fallback deployed
- [ ] Docs + migration guide published
- [ ] Deprecation email scheduled

kevin: SDK shim PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/432 (WIP)
riley: routing list posted to ops doc + infra ticket #8346 created
jordan: drafted email in Google Doc -> share link (will publish by EOD)
michael: canary ticket #8921 opened and assigned to infra-oncall
kevin: fixed flaky tests and pushed a patch, CI re-run in 6m
ci-bot: CI re-run passed for branch 'v2-compat-shim'
ana: thanks all — if no blockers we'll start a gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100% canary next Tue. weekly sync Tue 10:00 if needed. :thumbsup:
